newsitem.title: CANADA: Ledcor to install Canada-wide fibre-optic system.
newsitem.headline: Ledcor to install Canada-wide fibre-optic system.

text.p: Canadian Pacific Ltd unit Canadian Pacific Railway and Ledcor Industries Ltd said on Monday they agreed to establish a C$160 million fibre-optic system between Toronto and Vancouver and south to Montana.

The companies said Ledcor would install fibre-optic lines along CPR's right-of-way and provide Canadian telecommunications and cable companies a new infrastructure for voice, data and image transmissions.

The firms said the high-capacity telecommunications link would be installed across CPR's corridor, to Vancouver from from Toronto through Sudbury and Thunder Bay Ontario,, Winnipeg, Regina and Calgary.
The network would also include a link to the United States, with a line stretching south along CPR's right-of-way to the Alberta-Montana border.
The first phase of the project, to be complete by the end of 1998, was expected to start in western Canada, with connections laid between Vancouver and Calgary, as well as Calgary and Montana.
The project was to be carried out in conjunction with a CPR program to improve its signal and communications systems across the railway's network, the companies said.
